'''Tanido''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
A former member of [[Pierce's black ops team]], Tanido was stationed on Hoth by [[3640 BBY]], when [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] recalled him back for the old team. The occasion was special - [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] authorized Pierce to go after [[Bastion (Corellia)|the Bastion]], the Republic's best defended military complex on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Pierce trusted no one else except his old team to be qualified enough for the job. Tanido eagerly replied to Pierce's call and even prepared the special weapon he made for that exact occasion some time back. When the team was fully assembled, Rakton excused them for all other assignments and the team for the Bastion. Tanido's weapon lost power during the assault, but he managed to get it restored for when the fortress' gates were open. Pierce's team dealt with the security, killed the Bastion's commanding officer and took the base for the Empire.
